name: geo-man
description: GeoServer manager: connections, general info, layers and styles via REST.

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
